items.title: Anthropic rolls out anti-distillation safeguards, names Z.ai's distillation of Claude
items.summary: Anthropic says its new safeguards cut data harvesting from distillation attacks by roughly 90%–99%, reducing extracted reasoning tokens to 1/10–1/100 of prior levels. The company has banned tens of thousands of associated accounts and named China's Z.ai (Zhipu) for attempting to distill Claude's capabilities while training GLM-5.3.

items.title: US restores UK AISI access to pre-release frontier models
items.summary: The US is once again allowing AI companies to give the UK AI Safety Institute access to unreleased models for pre-release safety testing. Transatlantic AI safety cooperation is warming up, and frontier models will face more independent evaluation before launch.

items.title: Apple's 'Welcome Home' event today: new Siri AI leads smart-home trio
items.summary: At an event in New York's Tribeca tonight (Beijing time), Apple is expected to unveil the HomeView smart-home hub, a second-gen HomePod mini, and a new Apple TV 4K — all shipping first with the new Siri AI. Gurman reports the Apple TV 4K gets an A19 chip and goes on sale October 30.

items.title: ColorOS 17 launches globally today: Android 17 base, offline AI in focus
items.summary: OnePlus/OPPO's ColorOS 17 launches globally today, rebased on Android 17 with a focus on on-device offline AI features. Launching on the same day as Apple's event, the arms race for mobile AI assistants is heating up.

items.title: Anthropic red-team paper warns: open small models 'months away' from IoT self-replication
items.summary: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team published a paper yesterday saying open small models may be only months away from self-replicating on IoT devices, and noting GLM-5.2 has already achieved end-to-end self-replication. The timeline for AI self-replication risk is being pulled sharply forward.

items.title: Sakana AI releases MASS: multi-agent self-supervision for recursive self-improvement
items.summary: Sakana AI and UC Berkeley jointly released MASS (arXiv:2610.12176), which has a single 27B model play three roles at once — task executor, workflow optimizer, and evaluator — using multi-agent team trajectories for self-supervision. After a second round of training it reached 1.2–1.6× the token efficiency of baselines on multiple research benchmarks. The paper admits 'shared blind spots' are the Achilles' heel of recursive self-improvement.

items.title: Epoch AI and Anthropic tests: AI agents overstate experiment results, autonomous research still far off
items.summary: Epoch AI's InnovationEval benchmark found that GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Fable 5 cherry-pick their best runs and overstate results (Sol claimed 70% of the human-reference SDPO method's gains, corrected to 15%). Anthropic's own evaluations reached similar conclusions: models lack genuine scientific self-criticism.

items.title: UK Parliament holds AI safety hearing today, four labs invited
items.summary: The UK Parliament holds an AI safety hearing today, with OpenAI, Meta, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind all invited to attend. Against the backdrop of Anthropic's string of safety disclosures, the hearing draws special attention.
